items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah or the Rita Moreno syndrome when she won for, West Side Story.

ctx.x: It sounds like the Louise Fletcher syndrome.

Yeah or the Rita Moreno syndrome when she won for, West Side Story. She had been getting all kinds of parts before that, then all of a sudden she got typed as a Puerto Rican. I didn’t get typed, I have no idea to this day why that happened. People used to say, “Gee, maybe they thought your price went up to high.” I said, “Nobody ever asked.”
